name: My First Villain Monologue
source:
You made your plans, you executed your schemes, you bought your sharks and you hunted down the hero. And now it's finally time for your coup de grace: the anticipated, the dreaded, the magnificient, Villain Monologue.

[From [url=https://classheikki.itch.io/villain-monologue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你制定了你的计划，你执行了你的计划，你买了你的鲨鱼，你追捕了英雄。现在终于到了你致命一击的时候了：令人期待的、令人恐惧的、宏伟的反派独白。

[来自[url=https://classheikki.itch.io/villain-monologue]itch.io[/url]]
